items.title: 56422_Leonard Phillips oral history interview
items.q: he'd come up there doing Stepin Fetchit.

ctx.x: Well... I can't remember when that was... No, wouldn't nobody have missed him no way. He wasn't doin' nothin'. He'd go up there and try to sing and do a comedy act. It really wasn't no act. They hired him for singing, and he'd come up there doing Stepin Fetchit. That kind of stuff. So anyway, then he started stealing that money. He would get to go in town, and there was the tickets and things
